comments.author: @NelsonClick
comments.text: I met an older couple from Coober Pedy while I was in Germany. I talked to them for a good 20 minutes. They seemed like normal everyday people to me. When they said they were from Coober Pedy they were under the impression that I (an idiot American) would have never heard of it before. Well, of course I've heard of it and knew it was largely underground. It is one of the most unique towns in the whole world. They were so sweet. I will never forget them. This was in March 2011 in a sandwich shop in Heidelberg Germany.
